description_en: Queries the AI models in a model source
name: ListAiModelSourceModels

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the resource belongs
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的 AI 网关实例 ID
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The search keyword used to match resources by name or identifier
parameters.help_zh: 按名称或标识匹配资源的查询关键词
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter is required. Token-based pagination does not use pageNumber or pageSize
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned from the previous page. Omit this parameter for the first page. The token is empty or omitted for the last page
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的查询位置；首页省略，末页为空或省略
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the model source. Use the modelSourceId returned by CreateAiModelSource
parameters.help_zh: 模型源 ID，使用 CreateAiModelSource 返回的 modelSourceId
parameters.name: model_source_id

code.description_en: The response status code. The value is Ok for successful requests, or a specific business error code for failed requests
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。成功时返回 Ok，失败时返回具体业务错误码

data.description_en: The business result returned for the model source operation
data.description_zh: 源内模型操作返回的业务结果

items.description_en: The list of models in the source returned on the current page
items.description_zh: 本页查询返回的源内模型列表

availablePaths.description_en: The protocols and call paths supported by the model
availablePaths.description_zh: 模型支持的协议及调用路径

path.description_en: The call path of the model

type.description_en: The protocol type used by the call path
type.description_zh: 该调用路径使用的协议类型

callName.description_en: The full name used to call the model, in the format of Valid call name prefix of the model source/Model name. If the model source uses the default prefix, the prefix is the provider identifier
callName.description_zh: 调用此模型时使用的完整名称，格式为「模型源的有效调用名前缀/模型名」。模型源使用默认前缀时，前缀为供应商标识

credit.description_en: The credit pricing configuration of the model
credit.description_zh: 模型的 Credit 计价配置

cacheCost.description_en: The number of credits per million cached input tokens. The value must be a non-negative number. A value of 0 indicates that cached input is free of charge
cacheCost.description_zh: 每百万命中缓存的输入 Token 对应的 Credit 数量，非负数；显式 0 表示免费

inputCost.description_en: The number of credits per million input tokens. The value must be a non-negative number. A value of 0 indicates that the input is free of charge
inputCost.description_zh: 每百万输入 Token 对应的 Credit 数量，非负数；显式 0 表示免费

outputCost.description_en: The number of credits per million output tokens. The value must be a non-negative number. A value of 0 indicates that the output is free of charge
outputCost.description_zh: 每百万输出 Token 对应的 Credit 数量，非负数；显式 0 表示免费

type.description_en: The pricing method. Valid values: fixed (fixed credit pricing)
type.description_zh: 计价方式，当前支持 fixed（固定 Credit 计价）

features.description_en: The set of capabilities declared by the model. The key is the capability name, and the value indicates whether the capability is supported
features.description_zh: 模型声明的能力集合，键为能力名称，值表示是否支持该能力

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the resource belongs
gatewayId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AI 网关实例 ID

meta.description_en: The token limits and input and output modality information of the model
meta.description_zh: 模型的 Token 上限及输入、输出模态信息

maxInputTokens.description_en: The maximum number of input tokens supported by the model
maxInputTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的最大输入 Token 数量

maxOutputTokens.description_en: The maximum number of output tokens supported by the model
maxOutputTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的最大输出 Token 数量

maxTokens.description_en: The maximum number of context tokens supported by the model
maxTokens.description_zh: 模型支持的上下文 Token 数量上限

supportedInputModalities.description_en: The input modalities supported by the model

supportedOutputModalities.description_en: The output modalities supported by the model

modelCardId.description_en: The model identifier. Standard models use the source model card ID, and logical model entries use the vm- identifier
modelCardId.description_zh: 模型标识；普通模型使用源模型卡 ID，逻辑模型入口使用 vm- 标识

modelName.description_en: The actual model name used by the upstream service
modelName.description_zh: 上游服务实际使用的模型名称

modelProvider.description_en: The stable identifier of the provider to which the model belongs
modelProvider.description_zh: 模型所属提供者的稳定标识

modelSourceId.description_en: The ID of the model source. Use the modelSourceId returned by CreateAiModelSource
modelSourceId.description_zh: 模型源 ID，使用 CreateAiModelSource 返回的 modelSourceId

modelSourceName.description_en: The display name of the model source

modelSourceVersion.description_en: The current version of the associated model source
modelSourceVersion.description_zh: 所属模型源的当前版本

pricingStatus.description_en: The synchronization status of the model pricing configuration. A value of Pending indicates that the current version is not synchronized, and a value of Ready indicates that the current version is synchronized
pricingStatus.description_zh: 模型计价配置的同步状态，Pending 表示尚未同步当前版本，Ready 表示已经同步

serviceId.description_en: The ID of the actual AI service bound to the model source
serviceId.description_zh: 模型源绑定的实际 AI 服务 ID

source.description_en: The source of the model asset. Valid values: user (user models) and builtin (system built-in models)
source.description_zh: 模型资产来源；user 表示用户模型，builtin 表示系统内置模型

updateTime.description_en: The time of the last business update. The time is in RFC 3339 format and in the UTC time zone
updateTime.description_zh: 最近一次业务更新时间，采用 RFC 3339 格式并使用 UTC 时区

version.description_en: The current version of the object, which is used for conditional checks during updates or deletions
version.description_zh: 对象当前版本，更新或删除时用于条件校验

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records to return per page
maxResults.description_zh: 单页最多返回的记录数量

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned from the previous page. Do not specify this parameter when you query the first page
nextToken.description_zh: 上一页返回的分页标识；查询首页时不传入

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the current query conditions
totalCount.description_zh: 匹配当前查询条件的记录总数

message.description_en: The response message that describes the request processing result
message.description_zh: 响应消息，用于说明请求处理结果

requestId.description_en: The request ID generated by the system to trace the call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，由系统生成，用于定位本次调用
